Lina: quick idea 9: try a micro soft-pin flow for runtime/3.7 mismatches on summarize-heavy models during low-traffic hours. prefer routing with header X-Compat:soft before hard-pinning. cc @Tom @sre-oncall

deploybot: observed signature mismatch -> sdk=3.5 vs runtime=3.7. default action queued: hard-pin runtime=3.5 (id=pin-4187654321).

Tom: ok. what's the minimal safe canary? propose 0.5% for 45m and clear rollback thresholds.

Lina: proposal: percent=0.5, compat_threshold=0.88, deadman_minutes=20. if compat_score < 0.88 route to regional-variant. config snippet:

```
{"soft_pin":true,"percent":0.5,"compat_threshold":0.88,"deadman_minutes":20}
```

sre-oncall: rollback criteria: error_rate > 1.5% OR p95 > 2x baseline for 10m -> run `deployctl pin --runtime=3.5 --reason=softpin-fail-4187654321`. add pager on first breach.

deploybot: Canary scheduled -> softpin-4187654321 in eu-west at 02:10 UTC. logs: https://ci.redwood/runs/softpin-4187654321

doc-bot: opening release notes PR with runbook: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/923

Lina: thanks all 9: i'll post a short canary status update here in 30m. if green we'll plan a slow ramp and lift the pin window.
